info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Summaries API

params.name: rate_date
params.description: Date of the requested FX rates

params.name: bank_fee_pct
params.description: Percentage mark-up/fee (if applicable) an issuer would assess a cardholder on the cross-border/cross-currency transaction

params.name: bank_fee_fixed
params.description: Fixed mark-up/fee (if applicable) an issuer would assess a cardholder on the cross-border/cross-currency transaction (amount in cardholder billing currency)

items.docs: Provides Mastercard currency conversion rate, calculated cardholder billing amount, the ECB reference rate and the calculated percentage difference between Mastercard and ECB rate for the provided currency pair.
